картина: Руководство Gemini API по Batch API для разработчиков: асинхронная обработка больших объёмов за 50% стоимости, цель — 24 часа. Два способа подачи (inline до 20MB и JSONL-файл через File API до 2GB, рекомендован для больших пакетов), конфигурация на уровне запроса (system instructions, tools, модальности, structured output), эмбеддинги, состояния задания (EXPIRED после 48 ч), вебхуки, хранение результатов 6 недель, листинг/отмена/удаление, отдельный раздел «Generating images in batch» (Nano Banana: выше rate limits в обмен на до 24 ч; JSONL рекомендован для изображений; примеры на gemini-3-pro-image-preview с шаблонным промптом «A big letter A/B …» и responseModalities TEXT+IMAGE), технические детали (модальности как в обычном API, кэширование) и best practices (файл для больших пакетов, разбор ошибок по строкам, неидемпотентность создания, дробление больших пакетов). Код на Python/JS/Java/REST; все, кроме раздела изображений, — текстовые запросы.

единицы.утверждение_en: The Batch API is currently only available with the generateContent API.
единицы.цитата: This feature is currently only available with the generateContent API. Please follow the content on this page for more information.

единицы.утверждение_en: The Gemini Batch API processes large volumes of requests asynchronously at 50% of the standard cost.
единицы.цитата:
The Gemini Batch API is designed to process large volumes of requests
asynchronously at
50% of the standard cost
единицы.заметка: В Technical details уточнено: «50% of the standard interactive API cost for the equivalent model».

единицы.утверждение_en: The target turnaround time for a batch is 24 hours, though in most cases it is much quicker.

quicker.
единицы.заметка: Повторено в Technical details (SLO) и Best practices.

единицы.утверждение_en: Use the Batch API for large-scale, non-urgent tasks where an immediate response is not required (e.g., data pre-processing, running evaluations).
единицы.цитата:
Use Batch API for large-scale, non-urgent tasks such as data
pre-processing or running evaluations where an immediate response is not
required.

единицы.утверждение_en: Inline requests (a list of GenerateContentRequest objects in the batch creation request) suit smaller batches whose total request size stays under 20MB; the output is a list of inlineResponse objects.

smaller batches that keep the total request size under 20MB.

единицы.утверждение_en: An input JSONL file, where each line is a complete GenerateContentRequest, is recommended for larger requests; the output is a JSONL file where each line is a GenerateContentResponse or a status object.

file where each line contains a complete

единицы.утверждение_en: Creating a batch job returns a job name; use it to monitor the job status and to retrieve results once the job completes.
единицы.цитата: When you create a batch job, you will get a job name returned. Use this name

единицы.утверждение_en: A batch request can include any configuration used in a standard non-batch request, such as temperature, system instructions, or other modalities.

You can include any request configurations you would use in a standard non-batch

even pass in other modalities.

единицы.утверждение_en: A batch job's state is one of JOB_STATE_PENDING, JOB_STATE_RUNNING, JOB_STATE_SUCCEEDED, JOB_STATE_FAILED, JOB_STATE_CANCELLED, or JOB_STATE_EXPIRED; poll the job periodically using its name.

The state field of the batch job will indicate its current status. A batch job

единицы.утверждение_en: A job that runs or stays pending for more than 48 hours expires (JOB_STATE_EXPIRED) and has no results to retrieve; you can resubmit it or split the requests into smaller batches.
единицы.цитата:
: The job has expired because it was running or pending
for more than 48 hours. The job will not have any results to retrieve.
You can try submitting the job again or splitting up
the requests into smaller batches.

единицы.утверждение_en: Instead of polling, you can subscribe to webhooks (batch.succeeded; the code also subscribes to batch.failed) so the Gemini API pushes notifications to your server when the operation completes.
единицы.цитата:
directly to allow the Gemini API to push real-time
notifications to your server when asynchronous or long-running operations

единицы.утверждение_en: By default, batch job results are stored and available for download for 6 weeks, then permanently deleted.
единицы.цитата:
By default, batch job results are stored and available for download for 6 weeks,
before they are permanently deleted.

единицы.утверждение_en: Cancelling a batch job stops it from processing new requests; deleting a job also stops processing new requests and removes it from the list of batch jobs.
единицы.цитата:
You can cancel an ongoing batch job using its name. When a job is
canceled, it stops processing new requests.

единицы.утверждение_en: Batch job creation is not idempotent: sending the same creation request twice creates two separate batch jobs.
единицы.цитата:
The creation of a batch job is not idempotent.
If you send the same creation request twice, two separate batch jobs will
be created.

единицы.утверждение_en: Actual processing time varies with system load and job size; for large jobs, consider breaking them into smaller batches if intermediate results are needed sooner.
